setup.zh: 沉鼎观的正殿里没有神像，只有一口空的石座，四方，四足，大得能躺下一个人。石座前立着测灵石。
setup.en: There is no statue in the main hall — only an empty stone seat, square, on four feet, big enough for a person to lie in. Before it stands the spirit stone.

recap.zh: 入门仪式：测灵石测出你的灵根，观主说路长路短，不在灵根。
recap.en: The rite of entry: the spirit stone read your roots, and the abbot said the length of the road is not in the roots.

text.en: Tell me the day you were born.

label.en: Give your birthday · The root test

exits.means: gives the day they were born, or lets the stone read them — the page card asks it

text.en: {灵根}. — Whether the road is long or short is not in the roots.

text.zh: 他的目光在你袖口停了一瞬。你袖子里的铃，冰了一下。
text.en: His eyes rest on your sleeve a moment. The bell inside it turns cold.

text.zh: 灰袍、储物袋、一本《沉鼎观入门功法》，交到了你手里。从此观里的人叫你「{name}{兄姐}」。
text.en: A grey robe, a storage pouch and a copy of the temple's first manual are put into your hands. From today the temple calls you {兄姐} {name}.
